title: hand-rolled RFC3339 calendar in email/types.rs: O(n) year loop, no edge-case tests
description: email/types.rs implements hlc_ms_to_rfc3339 using hand-rolled date arithmetic (days_to_year_doy loops from 1970 one year at a time). For a timestamp 1000 years in the future, it loops 1000 times per call. More critically: doy_to_month_day has a fallback of (12,31) that is reached when rem is not exhausted by the months array — this can produce incorrect dates for inputs where accumulated day-in-year accounting is wrong. There are no test vectors against an independent implementation (e.g., chrono). This entire function should use chrono::DateTime::from_timestamp or equivalent.
